final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS u WHERE u.ID = p.ID AND u.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.`U-PRO`) <> '' AND u.`U-PRO` <> '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt) AS avg_alp_gpt FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX
